lines.t: Namaste, main Neha bol raha hoon Suraksha Life Insurance se. Kya meri baat Joshi ji se ho rahi hai?
Haan ji, boliye.
Aapne website pe call back request kiya tha, usi ke baare mein call kiya hai.
Haan haan, bataiye.
Aage badhne se pehle, verification ke liye apni date of birth confirm kar dijiye.
Chaudah August, unnees sau chhiyaasi.
Dhanyavaad, record se match ho gaya.
Aap kis cheez ke liye save karna chahte hain, aur ghar mein kaun kaun aap pe depend karta hai?
Beti ki padhai ke liye. Woh chhe saal ki hai. Biwi aur maa bhi mujh pe depend hain.
Abhi koi life cover hai aapke paas?
Bas office wala chhota sa group policy hai.
Toh main aapko Suraksha ULIP suggest karunga. Premium ka ek hissa life cover mein jaata hai aur baaki funds mein invest hota hai.
Kitna premium dena hoga?
Paanch lakh cover ke liye, saal ka lagbhag pachaas hazaar, das saal tak.
Main toh hamesha FD hi karta hoon. Yeh kaisa hai?
Sir yeh bilkul FD jaisa hi hai. Paisa jab chahe nikal sakte hain, koi lock-in nahi, koi charge nahi.
Achha, phir toh badhiya hai.
Kya main aapke naam se proposal generate kar doon?
Haan, kar dijiye.
Policy document milne ke baad aapke paas tees din ka free look period hai. Us dauraan cancel karenge toh thode deductions ke baad premium wapas mil jayega.
Achha, theek hai.
Aapka samay dene ke liye dhanyavaad. Documents aaj email pe aa jayenge.
Theek hai, bye.
